usage: deskops repo remove [-h] [--root ROOT] [--store STORE] selector

Remove a repository from the ecosystem registry so it can be registered again.

positional arguments:
  selector       Repository id, file stem, or repo-<id>. Selectors accept an
                 exact id, filename, stem, or unique slug fragment where
                 supported.

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT    Target repository root.
  --store STORE  Store path to anchor the registry lookup
